about.title: OCEANIC: Customs & Logistics
about.intro: OCEANIC is a leading company in customs clearance and industrial logistics in Algeria, offering an integrated solution combining specialized consulting, advanced training, and legal intelligence to enhance project performance.

conseil.title: Oceanic conseil
conseil.desc: Auditing and optimizing customs clearance and transport lead times and costs, managing appeals and disputes, streamlining procedures, and legal intelligence.

formation.title: Oceanic formation
formation.desc: Offering a wide range of training programs aimed at helping companies and their managers adopt and master best practices in customs clearance, logistics, and transportation.

veille.title: Oceanic veille juridique
veille.desc: Providing an extensive legislative and regulatory documentary database (International conventions, laws, decrees, orders, circulars, internal memos, case law, publications...).
